item.title: Four women sue Arkansas over pro-life law, but did they 'need' abortions?
item.description: Four women have joined a lawsuit against Arkansas over the state's pro-life law protecting most preborn children from abortion. The law, Act 180, allows induced abortion — the direct and intentional killing of a child in the womb — only when the mother's life is considered to be at risk.

item.title: West Virginia Senate committee advances bill restricting abortion pill distribution
item.description: Members of a West Virginia Senate committee advanced legislation Tuesday that would protect women by outlawing the mailing and distribution of chemical abortion drugs within the state.

item.title: Virginia lawmakers advance bill to legalize assisted suicide
item.description: Lawmakers in a Virginia Senate subcommittee advanced a bill Tuesday that would legalize assisted suicide in the state.

item.title: Chile moves towards outlawing surrogacy
item.description: Chile has taken a pivotal step towards forbidding surrogacy, advancing a bill that would ban and penalize the practice. The legislation continues its way through Parliament toward a final vote.

item.title: Woman praises 'abortion pill reversal': 'I'm so happy to be a mom'
item.description: (Pregnancy Help News) Circumstances, pressure, and fear often drive a woman to abortion. But Abortion Pill Reversal offers a second chance at choice.

item.title: 'It's surreal': New York family welcomes rare quintuplets
item.description: A New York couple unexpectedly saw their family size jump from four to nine, after conceiving quintuplets — an experience doctors describe as extremely rare.

item.title: ‘Indescribable’: Family overjoyed to take son born at 23 weeks home from NICU
item.description: After spending nearly 12 months fighting for his life in the NICU following his birth at just 23 weeks, Baby Aasiah Malcom is home with his parents and two older brothers — just in time to celebrate his first birthday.

item.title: South Carolina House passes bill to outlaw mail order abortion pill
item.description: The South Carolina House passed a bill this week to prevent the abortion pill from being mailed into the state.

item.title: Eastern European leaders address falling birth rate crisis
item.description: At a January 14 conference in Lithuania’s Parliament, regional experts, church leaders, and policymakers discussed falling birth rates.

item.title: Face of euthanized woman transplanted to another patient
item.description: The face of a woman who was euthanized has been successfully transplanted onto another woman in Spain.
